messages:
sahil: Cutting a release candidate for the runtime and routing changes. Candidate tag v1.12.0-rc3 (build abc123). Planning a promo today in the 17:00-18:00 PST change window. Need quick signoffs and decide artifact pin + rollback triggers. Release notes: https://go/release-notes/1.12.0-rc3

maria: Quick heads-up: smoke tests green in staging, no db migrations. Ran `make smoke` and `integration --env=staging` — both passed.

jen: I can own canary watch and alerting. What's the canary plan? percentage and duration?

sahil: Plan: canary 5% for 10m, if clean -> 25% for 10m -> 100% over 15m. If any SEV or error-rate spike >1% sustained for 3m OR p99 latency >2x baseline -> rollback. Also pin artifact in prod registry during the window.

oliver: LGTM on the plan. Suggest adding an automatic fallback to the previous pin (v1.11.7) if any deploy step fails. I'll prepare the rollback playbook snippet.

dev-bot: Deploy plan created: `deploy create --tag v1.12.0-rc3 --canary-schedule "5:10,25:10,100:15" --pin-artifact`

release-sheriff: Adding myself as sheriff for the window. I'll be on Pager during promo and will call rollback if we see regressions.

maria: One more note — optimizer quantization change can increase memory usage on older nodes. Recommend restricting canary to modern pool (gpu-v2) first.

sahil: Good catch. Updated plan: canary route -> gpu-v2 only for 5% and 25% stages. Full rollout will include gpu-v1 after smoke passes and memory metrics stable.

jen: Confirmed alerts set: `rc_canary_errors`, `rc_canary_latency`, `rc_smoke_failures`. Pager rules -> notify release-sheriff + oncall.

dev-bot: Starting canary rollout: v1.12.0-rc3 -> 5% on gpu-v2 (scope: service=runtime, route=/v1/generate).

jen: Smoke checks running: `inference-smoke` OK, `server-start` OK. No traces of OOM.

oliver: Observability: token-level latency + token-cost dashboards look nominal. error-rate 0.02% over last 5m.

release-sheriff: Monitoring manual checks + automated alerts. No anomalous client errors, memory stable. Proceeding to 25% after 10m.

dev-bot: Canary updated: 25% on gpu-v2.

maria: Post-25% checks green. No regressions in eval set, quality metrics within expected delta.

jen: Promoting to 100% per rollout plan. Pinning artifact in production registry now. Command: `registry pin v1.12.0-rc3 --env=prod --replace v1.11.7`

dev-bot: Artifact pinned: v1.12.0-rc3 pinned to prod. Starting 100% rollout.

release-sheriff: Final checks in progress. If stable for 15m, this is a full promo.

oliver: All post-promo checks passing. No rollback triggers hit.

sahil: Thanks team — promo complete and notes added to the release doc: https://go/release-notes/1.12.0-rc3. Rolling forward to stable tag in the morning after automated postprod metrics. :shipit: 

dev-bot: Deployment complete: v1.12.0-rc3 -> 100% prod. Logs: /deploy/logs/1943210000

release-sheriff: Signing off. If anything crops up overnight, follow rollback playbook: `deploy rollback --to-tag v1.11.7 --reason <sev>`

maria: Great work, everyone.

jen: Nice and smooth.

sahil: Closing thread.
